tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sits cross-legged on a low wooden stool, leaning forward to tie a shoelace, one hand gripping the lace near the shoe while the other holds the other lace end, tail curled beside the stool.

tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands clearly visible near the shoe with fingers distinct
tasks.intent_zh: 蓝虎坐矮凳弯腰系鞋带
